using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// Models from the project's zombie pack used by Invasión Zombi: animated zombies, props, vehicles and weapons.
/// Lives in Resources/SurvivalArtSet and is (re)generated by SurvivalSetup (Editor).
/// </summary>
[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Multiverse/Survival Art Set")]
public sealed class SurvivalArtSet : ScriptableObject
{
    [System.Serializable] public struct PropEntry { public string key; public GameObject prefab; }

    public PropEntry[] props;
    [Tooltip("Basic, Ribcage (runner), Chubby, Arm — animated prefabs.")] public GameObject[] zombies;
    public Material atlas;

    static SurvivalArtSet cached;
    public static SurvivalArtSet Get => cached != null ? cached : (cached = Resources.Load<SurvivalArtSet>("SurvivalArtSet"));

    public GameObject FindPrefab(string key)
    {
        if (props != null) foreach (var p in props) if (p.key == key && p.prefab != null) return p.prefab;
        return null;
    }
}

/// <summary>Runtime helpers: placing pack models with colliders, weapons, puffs.</summary>
public static class SurvivalKit
{
    /// <summary>Places a pack model scaled to a height, feet on the ground, with an optional box collider around it.</summary>
    public static GameObject Model(string key, Transform parent, Vector3 pos, float yaw, float height, bool solid, string name = null, bool fitLongest = false)
    {
        var art = SurvivalArtSet.Get;
        var prefab = art != null ? art.FindPrefab(key) : null;
        if (prefab == null) return null;
        var holder = new GameObject(name ?? key).transform;
        holder.SetParent(parent, false);
        holder.localPosition = pos;
        holder.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
        var visual = PirateArenaVisuals.AddModel(prefab, holder, height, art.atlas, false);
        foreach (var c in visual.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>()) Object.Destroy(c);
        if (fitLongest)
        {
            var fb = PirateArenaVisuals.BoundsOf(visual);
            visual.transform.localScale *= height / Mathf.Max(.001f, Mathf.Max(fb.size.x, Mathf.Max(fb.size.y, fb.size.z)));
            fb = PirateArenaVisuals.BoundsOf(visual);
            visual.transform.position += holder.position - new Vector3(fb.center.x, fb.min.y, fb.center.z);
        }
        if (solid)
        {
            var b = PirateArenaVisuals.BoundsOf(visual);
            var box = holder.gameObject.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();
            box.center = holder.InverseTransformPoint(b.center);
            box.size = b.size;
        }
        holder.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(0, yaw, 0);
        return holder.gameObject;
    }

    /// <summary>Instantiates a model so that its longest side measures <paramref name="length"/> and points along the holder's +Y.</summary>
    public static Transform Stick(string key, Transform holder, float length)
    {
        var art = SurvivalArtSet.Get;
        var prefab = art != null ? art.FindPrefab(key) : null;
        if (prefab == null) return null;
        var pivot = new GameObject(key).transform;
        pivot.SetParent(holder, false);
        var visual = Object.Instantiate(prefab, pivot, false);
        foreach (var c in visual.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>()) Object.Destroy(c);
        PirateArenaVisuals.ApplyMaterial(visual, art.atlas);
        // Measure in the pivot's space (pivot is still unrotated relative to the holder).
        var saved = holder.rotation; holder.rotation = Quaternion.identity;
        var b = PirateArenaVisuals.BoundsOf(visual);
        Vector3 s = b.size;
        float longest = Mathf.Max(s.x, Mathf.Max(s.y, s.z));
        visual.transform.localScale *= length / Mathf.Max(.001f, longest);
        b = PirateArenaVisuals.BoundsOf(visual);
        bool alongX = s.x >= s.y && s.x >= s.z, alongZ = !alongX && s.z >= s.y;
        Quaternion align = alongX ? Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90) : alongZ ? Quaternion.Euler(-90, 0, 0) : Quaternion.identity;
        Vector3 axis = alongX ? Vector3.right : alongZ ? Vector3.forward : Vector3.up;
        // Grip at one end of the longest side, so the model extends from the hand along +Y once aligned.
        Vector3 grip = b.center - Vector3.Scale(axis, b.extents);
        visual.transform.position += pivot.position - grip;
        pivot.localRotation = align;
        holder.rotation = saved;
        return pivot;
    }

    static readonly List<GameObject> puffPool = new();

    /// <summary>A short cartoon puff of spheres (no gore).</summary>
    public static void Puff(Vector3 at, Color color, int count = 7, float size = .5f)
    {
        var root = new GameObject("Nube").transform;
        root.position = at;
        var mat = EscapeKit.Paint(color, .05f);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var dir = Quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360f / count + Random.Range(-15f, 15f), 0) * Vector3.forward;
            var s = EscapeKit.Shape(PrimitiveType.Sphere, root, "Bola", dir * size * .3f + Vector3.up * Random.Range(0f, size * .6f), Vector3.one * size * Random.Range(.6f, 1f), mat, false);
            s.AddComponent<SurvivalPuffBall>().velocity = dir * Random.Range(1.2f, 2.6f) * size + Vector3.up * Random.Range(.6f, 1.8f) * size;
        }
        Object.Destroy(root.gameObject, .8f);
    }
}

public sealed class SurvivalPuffBall : MonoBehaviour
{
    public Vector3 velocity;
    float age; Vector3 start;
    void Start() => start = transform.localScale;
    void Update()
    {
        age += Time.deltaTime;
        transform.position += velocity * Time.deltaTime;
        velocity *= 1f - Time.deltaTime * 3f;
        transform.localScale = start * Mathf.Max(0f, 1f - age / .75f) * (1f + age);
    }
}

/// <summary>Walls and gate blockers: the camera ignores them so it can look over the barricades.</summary>
public sealed class SurvivalShell : MonoBehaviour { }
